action_items: No blocker. Optional nit: HistoryViewModel.setStatus signature is `(id: Long, status: String)` and the request description called RideStatus an 'enum'. Current implementation uses `object RideStatus { const val ACCEPTED = "ACCEPTED" ... }` and compiles cleanly end-to-end (DAO column is String). Converting to a real enum class would require a Room TypeConverter + a schema bump; not worth it since v4 is already fallbackToDestructiveMigration. Leave as-is unless strict enum semantics are later needed.

Optional (cosmetic, carry-over from iter8): mipmap-*/ic_launcher_foreground.png are still RGB rather than RGBA — adaptive-icon parallax may clip at corners under non-circular launcher masks. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ fitFirstRow() math is sound: fixed term dp(22+6+8+16)=52dp = logo width (22) + logo.rightMargin (6) + platformTv paddingEnd (8) + mini-space between blocks (16). rowAvailablePx = windowW − dpi(12) − dpi(36) correctly subtracts outer padding (2×6dp) + content padding (2×18dp). bigSp set once in build() from widthDp/13 coerced to [20,32]. bind() → apply(1f) resets sizes to base BEFORE measuring, then needed() uses Layout.getDesiredWidth(text, paint) which honors the RelativeSizeSpan(0.55f) applied to '/km' and '/h' unit tails — this is critical and correct. Scale factor applied with 0.97 safety margin — one pass is enough because needed() is linear in the scale factor.

✅ android.text.Layout and android.widget.ImageView imports present (lines 12 and 24). bigSp/rowAvailablePx are mutable fields initialized in build() before bind() is ever called (attach() → build(windowW) runs synchronously before show()→bind()).

✅ 41/41 JVM tests pass incl. 8 AcceptanceTracker tests covering the new PENDING paths: `sans preuve apres 30 s = A VALIDER`, `nouvelle offre pendant l'attente = la precedente est a valider`, `lecture remplacee alors que l'offre est visible = ignoree`, `meme offre relue apres une lecture ratee = pas de doublon`. Verified in source: AcceptanceTracker.offerVisible returns Result<T>(…, PENDING) when awaiting is replaced; silently returns null when current is replaced (correct: 'decided REJECTED but not returned').

✅ RideAccessibilityService.record() now saves every decision with status = decision.name, including PENDING — matches spec. handleScreen() still calls acceptance.onScreen(screenTexts) in both branches (OCR-not-ready + no-offer-parsed) so timeouts eventually produce PENDING records visible in HistoryScreen 'À valider'. Detection code (RideParser, ScreenOcr throttle, handleScreen filtering by Platforms.packages) is untouched otherwise.

✅ Room v4 schema: RideEntity gains status (String, default ACCEPTED), grossHourlyRateEuros (Double?), thresholdRatio (Double?); RideDao exposes updateStatus(id, status); AppDatabase version=4 with fallbackToDestructiveMigration — this is acceptable since the app is pre-release (versionCode 1).

✅ New ui/common/Period.kt + PeriodBar.kt + rewritten History/Stats compile against material3 1.2.0 (pinned by compose BOM 2024.02.00): DateRangePicker, rememberDateRangePickerState, DatePickerDialog and HorizontalDivider are all stable with @OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class) where needed. Period.entries requires Kotlin 1.9.22 (project uses 1.9.22 via compose compiler extension 1.5.8) — matches.
✅ grep across /app/drivee-copilote confirms no stale refs to removed HistoryFilter / weekRangeLabel / monthRangeLabel. CsvExporter still compatible — only uses RideEntity fields that still exist.
✅ DriveeNavHost bottomBar wraps NavigationBar in a Column with Text('Made by Faucobingo') on top, labelSmall onSurfaceVariant centered — compiles.

ℹ MINOR: HistoryViewModel.setStatus takes `status: String`, call-site passes RideStatus.REJECTED/ACCEPTED (which are String consts, not enum values) — compiles fine, consistent with DAO signature. Spec wording 'RideStatus.ACCEPTED/REJECTED/PENDING, default ACCEPTED' is implemented as string consts in an `object`, which is semantically equivalent for Room (TEXT column) and type-safer than loose strings. Not a bug.

ℹ MINOR: fitFirstRow() does a single-pass scale — if the user installs a very large system font scale that pushes needed() past 2× rowAvailable, 0.97 safety may not be enough. Acceptable in practice (bigSp is already coerced ≤ 32sp and widths scale linearly with font size). Could be a while-loop with 2 iterations if belt-and-suspenders is desired, but current math is correct for the reported case.

rca_of_issue: User-reported bug: when the VTC Copilot logo was added as the first row element in the offer popup, the trailing '€/h' value was cut (video showed 'UBER 0.90€/km 11.9€ 27' — '€/h' missing after '27'). ROOT CAUSE confirmed: the row holds logo(22dp)+margin(6dp) + platform text + perKm (bigSp with /km suffix at 0.55×) + spacer + price (bigSp+2) + spacer + hourly (bigSp with /h suffix at 0.55×), inside a card with 2×6dp outer padding + 2×18dp content padding. On a 384dp physical screen (windowW=376dp), rowAvailable ≈ 328dp (902px @ density 2.75) but natural natural need @1x ≈ 360dp (990px) — overflow ~32dp (~88px). Since the row is a horizontal LinearLayout where the two inner weight-1 spacers (not the texts) absorb free space but texts can't shrink past their intrinsic width, the last child (hourlyTv) gets clipped by the parent → '27' visible, '€/h' chopped. MITIGATION applied in bind()→fitFirstRow(): measure total intrinsic width via Layout.getDesiredWidth across the 4 TextViews (honoring the 0.55× RelativeSizeSpan on unit tails), compute fixed-term dp(22+6+8+16)=52dp, if the sum exceeds rowAvailablePx scale all four text sizes by (rowAvailablePx / need) × 0.97 (0.97 safety). JVM simulation confirms scale=0.883 produces need=891px ≤ 902px — row fits, '€/h' no longer clipped. Base sizes are reset each bind() by apply(1f) before measurement so repeated bind()s don't shrink forever. Detection code (RideParser, ScreenOcr, AcceptanceTracker.offerVisible/offerGone, handleScreen) unchanged beyond adding record()→save with decision.name. 41/41 JVM tests PASS.
